## Section C: Reframe Rules (Aspirations Stated as Aspirations Only)

### certifications.html — Rename and Reframe as "Security & Compliance Roadmap"

The certifications page must be retitled and restructured as a roadmap page, not a credentials page. Use only the following facts and framings:

- SAM.gov registered (Active) — this is the one current, verified credential; state it as fact
- Pursuing CMMC alignment — use "pursuing," never "certified" or "compliant"
- Building toward NIST 800-171 practices — use "building toward," never "compliant"
- HUBZone application submitted — state as pending, never as awarded or certified
- Intent to pursue Facility Clearance (FCL) sponsorship — forward-looking intent only
- PQC/quantum-readiness expertise on staff — this is a capability claim, not a certification

Permissible verbs throughout this page: "pursuing," "building toward," "designed to align with," "intend to pursue," "submitted," "working toward." Never: "certified," "compliant," "authorized," "registered" (except for SAM.gov), "cleared" (as an organizational certification).

## Section E: Partner Ecosystem (The Ravonics Model — Honest)

Ravonics is the **federal go-to-market and compliance bridge**. It does not own the core IP. Its value proposition is bringing commercial-grade IP into government, wrapped with federal contracting expertise, security architecture, CMMC/compliance frameworks, and PII/ATO program management that the IP owners lack.

Describe the ecosystem as our own affiliated companies and a research partner. Do not overstate any external relationship that is not documented.

### Affiliated Partner Entities

**Dream Limited** — capture/proposal automation and business-operations platforms.

**Droid Ops Inc** — DevSecOps and compliance automation. Maintainer of the "Launch Sequence" secure software supply-chain pipeline: 150+ NIST 800-53 controls, signed artifacts, continuous cATO evidence generation.

**Viper Dynamics** — real-time multi-domain situational awareness and intelligence fusion.

**INSTAR Lab Inc** — 501(c)(3) nonprofit research institute. Our R&D and SBIR/STTR research arm. Home of the applied physics research bench. Chaired by Ravonics founder Sean Hackney.

**FocusApiary** — zero-trust Kubernetes infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code (IaC). Supporting role in the ecosystem.

**Talent and training affiliates** — supporting workforce development pipeline. (Do not name specific affiliates unless documented.)

## Section F: Capability Pillars (Abstracted from Real IP — 7 Pillars)

Describe each pillar in terms of capability and federal value. Do not publish internal product names (see Section G). These seven pillars are the organizing framework for the capabilities/services section of the site.

**1. Software Delivery & Compliance**
Secure software supply-chain automation. 150+ NIST 800-53 controls. Signed artifacts (SBOM and attestation). Continuous cATO evidence generation. Policy-as-code enforcement throughout the pipeline.

**2. Operations & Visibility**
Unified multi-cluster operations dashboard. Real-time health, security posture, incident, and SLO signals consolidated into a single operational view for mission-critical environments.

**3. AI-Assisted / Agentic Delivery**
Autonomous pipeline from requirement through architecture, code, and deployment, with full decision audit trails. Hierarchical agent orchestration. This is Ravonics' genuine technical differentiator.

**4. Capture & Proposal Automation**
Federal opportunity intake and deduplication. Bid/no-bid (Pwin) scoring. Compliance-matrix generation. Proposal volume drafting. Pricing strategy support.

**5. Inference & Model Optimization**
Federated GPU inference (local plus cloud overflow, OpenAI-compatible API surface, cost transparency). Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model compression for edge and on-premises deployment in bandwidth- or connectivity-constrained environments.

**6. Situational Awareness & Intelligence**
Multi-domain 3D operational picture fusing AIS, ADS-B, satellite, weather, and hazard feeds. AI-driven object detection for field and ISR operations.

**7. Zero-Trust Infrastructure & Research**
Immutable Kubernetes, zero-trust networking overlay, GitOps, encrypted secrets management. Agentic R&D and applied-physics research conducted through INSTAR Lab.

## Section H: White Papers and Publications (Planned — Teasers Only)

List the following as planned white papers. Mark every entry as "Forthcoming." Do not fabricate DOIs, journal acceptances, conference proceedings references, or publication dates.

**"Policy-as-Code for Federal Software Procurement"**
Examines how declarative policy frameworks can automate compliance enforcement across the federal acquisition and software delivery lifecycle, reducing manual audit burden and accelerating ATO timelines.

**"Automated Evidence Generation for NIST 800-53 cATO"**
Describes an evidence-pipeline approach to continuous Authorization to Operate (cATO), generating audit-ready artifacts at each stage of the software supply chain rather than as a point-in-time assessment.

**"Defending the Software Supply Chain: SBOM, Attestation & VEX"**
Analyzes Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), artifact attestation, and Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) as interoperable standards for federal software provenance and vulnerability management.

**"Hierarchical Agentic Software Delivery: From Requirement to Deployed Capability"**
Explores multi-tier autonomous agent orchestration as a software delivery paradigm, including decision audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and compliance integration at each delivery stage.

**"Hybrid GPU Inference for Sensitive Workloads"**
Addresses the architecture and cost-transparency considerations for running AI inference across local on-premises GPU resources and commercial cloud overflow in environments with data sensitivity or connectivity constraints.

**"Multi-Domain Situational Awareness Through Open-Source Data Fusion"**
Reviews methodologies for fusing publicly available maritime, airspace, satellite, and environmental data streams into a coherent multi-domain operational picture using open standards.

**"Post-Quantum Readiness for Federal Systems (FIPS 203/204/205)"**
Provides a readiness framework for federal IT modernization aligned to NIST's post-quantum cryptography standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA), covering migration strategy, dependency mapping, and cryptographic agility.

## Section I: Tone and Integrity Rules

These rules apply to every page, every copywriting pass, every revision, and every QA check.

1. **Honest and capability-based.** Ravonics is a new company. Never imply otherwise. Confidence in capabilities is appropriate; implied longevity or scale that does not exist is not.

2. **No unverifiable metrics.** No number, percentage, or statistic is presented as a Ravonics company achievement unless it is directly verifiable from a cited, documentable source. Use the pillar descriptions in Section F — they are deliberately written without invented metrics.

3. **No social proof fabrication.** No client logos. No named government endorsements. No star ratings. No review counts. No "trusted by" language unless a named, verifiable entity has authorized that statement in writing.

4. **Footer consistency.** The legal footer on every page must display the following identifiers identically — same casing, same order, no abbreviation:
   - Ravonics LLC
   - UEI: YCBDVKN1A9G7
   - CAGE: 20DS8
   - 313 Walnut St, Ravenswood, WV 26164
   - SAM.gov registered (Active)
   - contact@ravonics.com

5. **Forward-looking language discipline.** When describing aspirational states (certifications in pursuit, future capabilities, planned publications), use only: pursuing, building toward, designed to align with, intend to pursue, submitted, working toward, forthcoming. Never use completed-state language for incomplete states.

6. **Attribution discipline.** Career accomplishments belonging to Sean Hackney from his prior roles must be explicitly attributed to him by name as an individual, with clear language that these reflect his career history — not Ravonics company history.

7. **Partner relationship accuracy.** Do not describe any affiliated entity as a "subsidiary," "division," or "wholly owned" entity unless that corporate relationship is legally documented. Use "affiliated company," "research partner," or "ecosystem partner" as appropriate.

8. **HUBZone accuracy.** Ravenswood, WV is a designated HUBZone location. Ravonics is headquartered there. The SBA HUBZone certification application has been submitted. It has NOT been awarded. Never write "HUBZone certified" — write "HUBZone certification pending" or "SBA HUBZone application submitted."

9. **One source of truth.** This file is the canonical reference. If any other document, brief, or instruction contradicts this spec, this spec takes precedence. Escalate conflicts in writing rather than resolving them silently by choosing the other source.
